objects.description: Primary driver class for the MFRC522 RFID/NFC reader IC. Provides register maps, commands, enums, and methods to initialize the reader, perform self-test, communicate with PICCs (cards/tags), handle MIFARE operations, and dump debug info. Owns nested types like Uid and MIFARE_Key and exposes status/type enums.
UID container for a PICC, holding length, up to 10 UID bytes, and the SAK byte returned after selection.
Container for a 6-byte MIFARE Crypto1 key used during authentication.

objects.definition:
enum PCD_Register : byte {
	CommandReg = 0x01 << 1,
	ComIEnReg = 0x02 << 1,
	DivIEnReg = 0x03 << 1,
	ComIrqReg = 0x04 << 1,
	DivIrqReg = 0x05 << 1,
	ErrorReg = 0x06 << 1,
	Status1Reg = 0x07 << 1,
	Status2Reg = 0x08 << 1,
	FIFODataReg = 0x09 << 1,
	FIFOLevelReg = 0x0A << 1,
	WaterLevelReg = 0x0B << 1,
	ControlReg = 0x0C << 1,
	BitFramingReg = 0x0D << 1,
	CollReg = 0x0E << 1,
	ModeReg = 0x11 << 1,
	TxModeReg = 0x12 << 1,
	RxModeReg = 0x13 << 1,
	TxControlReg = 0x14 << 1,
	TxASKReg = 0x15 << 1,
	TxSelReg = 0x16 << 1,
	RxSelReg = 0x17 << 1,
	RxThresholdReg = 0x18 << 1,
	DemodReg = 0x19 << 1,
	MfTxReg = 0x1C << 1,
	MfRxReg = 0x1D << 1,
	SerialSpeedReg = 0x1F << 1,
	CRCResultRegH = 0x21 << 1,
	CRCResultRegL = 0x22 << 1,
	ModWidthReg = 0x24 << 1,
	RFCfgReg = 0x26 << 1,
	GsNReg = 0x27 << 1,
	CWGsPReg = 0x28 << 1,
	ModGsPReg = 0x29 << 1,
	TModeReg = 0x2A << 1,
	TPrescalerReg = 0x2B << 1,
	TReloadRegH = 0x2C << 1,
	TReloadRegL = 0x2D << 1,
	TCounterValueRegH = 0x2E << 1,
	TCounterValueRegL = 0x2F << 1,
	TestSel1Reg = 0x31 << 1,
	TestSel2Reg = 0x32 << 1,
	TestPinEnReg = 0x33 << 1,
	TestPinValueReg = 0x34 << 1,
	TestBusReg = 0x35 << 1,
	AutoTestReg = 0x36 << 1,
	VersionReg = 0x37 << 1,
	AnalogTestReg = 0x38 << 1,
	TestDAC1Reg = 0x39 << 1,
	TestDAC2Reg = 0x3A << 1,
	TestADCReg = 0x3B << 1
};
objects.description: Enum of MFRC522 register addresses (shifted for SPI addressing). Used to read/write device registers.

objects.definition:
enum PCD_Command : byte {
	PCD_Idle = 0x00,
	PCD_Mem = 0x01,
	PCD_GenerateRandomID = 0x02,
	PCD_CalcCRC = 0x03,
	PCD_Transmit = 0x04,
	PCD_NoCmdChange = 0x07,
	PCD_Receive = 0x08,
	PCD_Transceive = 0x0C,
	PCD_MFAuthent = 0x0E,
	PCD_SoftReset = 0x0F
};
objects.description: Enum of MFRC522 command codes to control device operations.

objects.definition:
enum PCD_RxGain : byte {
	RxGain_18dB = 0x00 << 4,
	RxGain_23dB = 0x01 << 4,
	RxGain_18dB_2 = 0x02 << 4,
	RxGain_23dB_2 = 0x03 << 4,
	RxGain_33dB = 0x04 << 4,
	RxGain_38dB = 0x05 << 4,
	RxGain_43dB = 0x06 << 4,
	RxGain_48dB = 0x07 << 4,
	RxGain_min = 0x00 << 4,
	RxGain_avg = 0x04 << 4,
	RxGain_max = 0x07 << 4
};
objects.description: Enum bit masks for configuring MFRC522 receiver gain in RFCfgReg.

objects.definition:
enum PICC_Command : byte {
	PICC_CMD_REQA = 0x26,
	PICC_CMD_WUPA = 0x52,
	PICC_CMD_CT = 0x88,
	PICC_CMD_SEL_CL1 = 0x93,
	PICC_CMD_SEL_CL2 = 0x95,
	PICC_CMD_SEL_CL3 = 0x97,
	PICC_CMD_HLTA = 0x50,
	PICC_CMD_RATS = 0xE0,
	PICC_CMD_MF_AUTH_KEY_A = 0x60,
	PICC_CMD_MF_AUTH_KEY_B = 0x61,
	PICC_CMD_MF_READ = 0x30,
	PICC_CMD_MF_WRITE = 0xA0,
	PICC_CMD_MF_DECREMENT = 0xC0,
	PICC_CMD_MF_INCREMENT = 0xC1,
	PICC_CMD_MF_RESTORE = 0xC2,
	PICC_CMD_MF_TRANSFER = 0xB0,
	PICC_CMD_UL_WRITE = 0xA2
};
objects.description: Enum of PICC command bytes used over the RF interface, including MIFARE and ISO14443-3/4 commands.
Miscellaneous constants for MIFARE protocol: 4-bit ACK value and key size.

objects.definition:
enum PICC_Type : byte {
	PICC_TYPE_UNKNOWN        ,
	PICC_TYPE_ISO_14443_4    ,
	PICC_TYPE_ISO_18092      ,
	PICC_TYPE_MIFARE_MINI    ,
	PICC_TYPE_MIFARE_1K      ,
	PICC_TYPE_MIFARE_4K      ,
	PICC_TYPE_MIFARE_UL      ,
	PICC_TYPE_MIFARE_PLUS    ,
	PICC_TYPE_MIFARE_DESFIRE ,
	PICC_TYPE_TNP3XXX        ,
	PICC_TYPE_NOT_COMPLETE = 0xff
};
objects.description: Enumeration of detected PICC types returned from SAK and related logic.

objects.definition:
enum StatusCode : byte {
	STATUS_OK              ,
	STATUS_ERROR           ,
	STATUS_COLLISION       ,
	STATUS_TIMEOUT         ,
	STATUS_NO_ROOM         ,
	STATUS_INTERNAL_ERROR  ,
	STATUS_INVALID         ,
	STATUS_CRC_WRONG       ,
	STATUS_MIFARE_NACK     = 0xff
};
objects.description: Return/status codes used by MFRC522 API calls.
Extended driver class adding ISO/IEC 14443-4 features (ATS, PPS, block-chaining) on top of MFRC522, including higher-bit-rate negotiation and T=CL framing helpers.
Enumeration of ISO/IEC 14443-4 bit rates used for PPS (D values).
Structure holding parsed ISO/IEC 14443-4 ATS parameters (TA1/TB1/TC1) and raw ATS bytes.
Aggregates ISO14443-3 ATQA, MFRC522::Uid, ISO14443-4 ATS, and current I-block toggle state for a selected tag.
Represents an ISO/IEC 14443-4 PCB block with optional CID/NAD and INF payload for T=CL exchanges.

functions.name: MFRC522::MFRC522
functions.description: Default constructor for an MFRC522 reader object. Use when you will later call PCD_Init() with pins configured elsewhere. Intended to set up internal members but does not initialize hardware by itself.
requirements: After construction, call one of PCD_Init() overloads before attempting any card communication.
SPI pins and power must be properly wired to the MFRC522 before initialization.

functions.name: MFRC522::MFRC522
functions.description: Constructor specifying the MFRC522 NRSTPD (reset/power-down) pin. Use when the SPI chip-select pin is defined elsewhere or uses a default. Hardware is not initialized until PCD_Init() is called.
requirements: resetPowerDownPin must be a valid Arduino digital pin connected to MFRC522 NRSTPD.
Call a matching PCD_Init(resetPowerDownPin) or PCD_Init(chipSelectPin, resetPowerDownPin) before use.

functions.name: MFRC522::MFRC522
functions.description: Constructor specifying both the SPI chip-select (NSS) and the reset/power-down (NRSTPD) pins for the MFRC522. Hardware is not initialized until PCD_Init() is called.
requirements: chipSelectPin must be connected to MFRC522 NSS (SS) pin.
resetPowerDownPin must be connected to MFRC522 NRSTPD pin.
Call PCD_Init(chipSelectPin, resetPowerDownPin) before communication.

functions.name: MFRC522::PCD_WriteRegister
functions.description: Writes a single byte to an MFRC522 register via SPI.
requirements: reg must be a valid PCD_Register value.
The MFRC522 must be powered and SPI bus initialized via PCD_Init() before calling.

functions.name: MFRC522::PCD_WriteRegister
functions.signature: void MFRC522::PCD_WriteRegister(PCD_Register reg, byte count, byte *values)
functions.description: Writes multiple bytes to an MFRC522 register/FIFO via SPI.
requirements: values must point to a buffer with at least count bytes.
count must not exceed the device FIFO/register capacity (FIFO is 64 bytes).
The MFRC522 must be initialized (PCD_Init()).

functions.name: MFRC522::PCD_ReadRegister
functions.description: Reads a single byte from an MFRC522 register via SPI.
requirements: reg must be a valid PCD_Register value.
MFRC522 must be initialized and powered.

functions.name: MFRC522::PCD_ReadRegister
functions.signature: void MFRC522::PCD_ReadRegister(PCD_Register reg, byte count, byte *values, byte rxAlign = 0)
functions.description: Reads multiple bytes from an MFRC522 register/FIFO into a caller-provided buffer.
requirements: values must point to a buffer with space for at least count bytes.
count must not exceed the FIFO size (64 bytes).
rxAlign, if used, should be in the range 0..7 indicating bit alignment.
MFRC522 must be initialized (PCD_Init()).

functions.name: MFRC522::PCD_SetRegisterBitMask
functions.description: Sets (ORs) specific bits in an MFRC522 register as indicated by mask.
requirements: reg must be a valid PCD_Register value.
MFRC522 must be initialized.
mask specifies the bits to set; only valid bits for the target register should be used.

functions.name: MFRC522::PCD_ClearRegisterBitMask
functions.description: Clears (ANDs inverse) specific bits in an MFRC522 register as indicated by mask.
requirements: reg must be a valid PCD_Register value.
MFRC522 must be initialized.
mask specifies the bits to clear; only valid bits for the target register should be used.

functions.name: MFRC522::PCD_CalculateCRC
functions.description: Uses the MFRC522 hardware CRC coprocessor to compute CRC_A over the supplied data buffer.
requirements: data must point to at least length bytes.
result must point to a buffer that can hold the two CRC bytes (LSB, MSB).
Check the returned StatusCode for success (STATUS_OK).
MFRC522 must be initialized.

functions.name: MFRC522::PCD_Init
functions.description: Initializes the MFRC522 with previously configured pins and default SPI clock (up to 4 MHz unless overridden). Powers up the chip and prepares it for communication.
requirements: Use only if the object was constructed with pin information available to the instance.
Call on a powered and wired MFRC522. SPI library must be available.

functions.name: MFRC522::PCD_Init
functions.description: Initializes the MFRC522 specifying the NRSTPD pin to control reset/power-down during setup.
requirements: resetPowerDownPin must be the Arduino pin connected to NRSTPD.
MFRC522 must be wired correctly; call in setup before card operations.

functions.name: MFRC522::PCD_Init
functions.description: Initializes the MFRC522 specifying both SPI chip-select (NSS) and reset/power-down (NRSTPD) pins. Configures SPI and the reader for operation.
requirements: chipSelectPin connected to MFRC522 NSS.
resetPowerDownPin connected to MFRC522 NRSTPD.
Call once during startup before other MFRC522 operations.

functions.name: MFRC522::PCD_Reset
functions.description: Issues a soft reset to the MFRC522 (PCD_SoftReset command) to return it to a known state.
requirements: MFRC522 must be powered and SPI-accessible.
Allow time after reset if followed by operations that require stable RF settings.

functions.name: MFRC522::PCD_AntennaOn
functions.description: Enables the RF field by turning on the MFRC522 antenna drivers (TX1/TX2). Required before PICC communication.
requirements: Call after PCD_Init().
Only call when an antenna and matching network are present to avoid damage.

functions.name: MFRC522::PCD_AntennaOff
functions.description: Disables the RF field by turning off the MFRC522 antenna drivers. Useful for power saving or when not communicating.
requirements: MFRC522 must be initialized.
Beware that PICC communication will fail while antenna is off.

functions.name: MFRC522::PCD_GetAntennaGain
functions.description: Returns the current configured receiver gain (RxGain) mask from the RF configuration register.
requirements: MFRC522 must be initialized.
Interpretation of the returned mask uses the PCD_RxGain enum.

functions.name: MFRC522::PCD_SetAntennaGain
functions.description: Configures the receiver gain by writing the provided RxGain mask to the appropriate register.
requirements: mask should be one of the PCD_RxGain values (e.g., RxGain_avg).
MFRC522 must be initialized.

functions.name: MFRC522::PCD_PerformSelfTest
functions.description: Runs the MFRC522 built-in digital self-test and compares results with known firmware reference patterns stored in PROGMEM. Returns true if the self-test passes.
requirements: MFRC522 must be initialized and idle.
The antenna can typically be off during digital self-test (implementation dependent).
Caller should handle false return as a hardware/connection issue.

functions.name: MFRC522::PCD_SoftPowerDown
functions.description: Puts the MFRC522 into soft power-down mode by setting the PowerDown bit in CommandReg.
requirements: MFRC522 must be initialized.
All ongoing communication must be stopped before entering power-down.

functions.name: MFRC522::PCD_SoftPowerUp
functions.description: Wakes the MFRC522 from soft power-down mode by clearing the PowerDown bit in CommandReg.
requirements: Device must have been placed into soft power-down.
Allow time after power-up before starting communication.

functions.name: MFRC522::PCD_TransceiveData
functions.signature: MFRC522::StatusCode MFRC522::PCD_TransceiveData(byte *sendData, byte sendLen, byte *backData, byte *backLen, byte *validBits = nullptr, byte rxAlign = 0, bool checkCRC = false)
functions.description: Low-level helper to transmit data from the FIFO to the RF field and receive the PICC response. Wraps the Transceive command and handles framing details.
requirements: sendData must point to at least sendLen bytes.
backData must be a valid buffer if backLen is non-null; backLen must point to a variable containing input buffer capacity and will be updated with response length.
validBits, if provided, points to the number of valid bits in the last received byte; rxAlign must be 0..7.
If checkCRC is true, the function may validate CRC in the response; caller must examine the returned StatusCode.
MFRC522 must be initialized and antenna enabled.

functions.name: MFRC522::PCD_CommunicateWithPICC
functions.signature: MFRC522::StatusCode MFRC522::PCD_CommunicateWithPICC(byte command, byte waitIRq, byte *sendData, byte sendLen, byte *backData = nullptr, byte *backLen = nullptr, byte *validBits = nullptr, byte rxAlign = 0, bool checkCRC = false)
functions.description: Core routine to start a PCD command (e.g., Transceive), wait for specific IRQ flags, and exchange data with a PICC. Basis for higher-level card operations.
requirements: command must be a valid PCD_Command value.
waitIRq must specify the expected IRQ mask bits to wait for.
sendData must contain at least sendLen bytes.
If backLen is non-null, it must point to capacity on input and will be updated with the received length; backData must have at least that capacity.
validBits optional; rxAlign in 0..7.
Caller must check returned StatusCode.
MFRC522 must be initialized; antenna should be on.

functions.name: MFRC522::PICC_RequestA
functions.description: Sends a REQA (7-bit) to detect ISO14443A PICCs in IDLE and retrieves the ATQA (Answer To Request) response.
requirements: bufferATQA must point to a buffer; ATQA is 2 bytes for Type A cards.
bufferSize must point to a value initially holding the buffer capacity; will be updated with the actual length.
Antenna must be on; MFRC522 initialized.
Caller must check StatusCode.

functions.name: MFRC522::PICC_WakeupA
functions.description: Sends a WUPA (7-bit) to wake ISO14443A PICCs in IDLE/HALT and retrieves the ATQA response.
requirements: bufferATQA must have space for the ATQA (typically 2 bytes).
bufferSize must provide the buffer capacity and will be updated with actual size.
Antenna must be on; MFRC522 initialized.
Caller must check StatusCode.

functions.name: MFRC522::PICC_REQA_or_WUPA
functions.description: Helper to send either REQA or WUPA (7-bit frame) and receive ATQA.
requirements: command must be PICC_CMD_REQA or PICC_CMD_WUPA.
bufferATQA must have space (typically 2 bytes).
bufferSize must point to capacity on input and will be updated with response length.
MFRC522 initialized; antenna on; caller checks StatusCode.

functions.name: MFRC522::PICC_Select
functions.description: Performs the anti-collision and selection sequence to select a single PICC and fill the provided Uid structure. Handles cascade levels and returns a status.
requirements: uid must point to a valid Uid struct; on input, uid and validBits may indicate a partially known UID; on success, uid is populated and sak set.
validBits should be 0..7 for partial-byte alignment when used.
MFRC522 initialized; antenna on; caller must check StatusCode.

functions.name: MFRC522::PICC_HaltA
functions.description: Sends the HLTA command to put the currently selected PICC into the HALT state.
requirements: A PICC should have been selected beforehand for meaningful effect.
MFRC522 initialized; antenna on; caller checks StatusCode.

functions.name: MFRC522::PCD_Authenticate
functions.signature: MFRC522::StatusCode MFRC522::PCD_Authenticate(byte command, byte blockAddr, MIFARE_Key *key, Uid *uid)
functions.description: Runs MIFARE Classic authentication (Key A or Key B) for a given block address using the provided key and UID. Must be called before MIFARE read/write/value operations on Classic cards.
requirements: command must be PICC_CMD_MF_AUTH_KEY_A or PICC_CMD_MF_AUTH_KEY_B.
blockAddr must be a valid MIFARE Classic block number for the card type.
key must point to a valid MIFARE_Key with 6 bytes set.
uid must point to the UID of the selected PICC.
Caller must check StatusCode; on failure, subsequent MIFARE operations will fail.

functions.name: MFRC522::PCD_StopCrypto1
functions.description: Stops the Crypto1 encryption on the PCD side after MIFARE Classic authenticated operations are complete.
requirements: Call after finishing MIFARE Classic operations that required authentication.
The reader must be initialized.

functions.name: MFRC522::MIFARE_Read
functions.description: Reads one 16-byte data block from a previously authenticated MIFARE Classic sector (or compatible Ultralight read) into the provided buffer.
requirements: blockAddr must refer to a readable block on the PICC.
Authentication via PCD_Authenticate is required for MIFARE Classic before reading.
buffer must be non-null; bufferSize must point to available capacity on input and is set to actual received length.
Provide enough space for data plus protocol bytes; exact overhead is implementation-defined.
Caller must check StatusCode.

functions.name: MFRC522::MIFARE_Write
functions.signature: MFRC522::StatusCode MFRC522::MIFARE_Write(byte blockAddr, byte *buffer, byte bufferSize)
functions.description: Writes one 16-byte data block to a previously authenticated MIFARE Classic block. For Ultralight, this maps to COMPATIBILITY WRITE behavior.
requirements: blockAddr must refer to a writable data block.
Authentication via PCD_Authenticate is required for MIFARE Classic before writing.
buffer must point to at least bufferSize bytes; for Classic, bufferSize should be 16 bytes.
Caller must check StatusCode.

functions.name: MFRC522::MIFARE_Ultralight_Write
functions.signature: MFRC522::StatusCode MFRC522::MIFARE_Ultralight_Write(byte page, byte *buffer, byte bufferSize)
functions.description: Writes one 4-byte page on MIFARE Ultralight (and compatible) PICCs.
requirements: page must be a valid Ultralight page address.
buffer must contain the 4 bytes to write; bufferSize must be 4.
Caller must check StatusCode.

functions.name: MFRC522::MIFARE_Decrement
functions.description: Performs a MIFARE Classic DECREMENT operation on a value block, storing the result in the internal transfer register.
requirements: blockAddr must refer to a valid value block already initialized as such.
Authentication via PCD_Authenticate is required before the operation.
delta specifies the amount to subtract; its valid range depends on MIFARE value semantics (implementation-defined).
Caller must follow with MIFARE_Transfer to write back the result and check StatusCode.

functions.name: MFRC522::MIFARE_Increment
functions.description: Performs a MIFARE Classic INCREMENT operation on a value block, storing the result in the internal transfer register.
requirements: blockAddr must refer to a valid value block.
Authenticate first using PCD_Authenticate.
delta specifies the amount to add; valid range per MIFARE spec.
Follow with MIFARE_Transfer to commit and check StatusCode.

functions.name: MFRC522::MIFARE_Restore
functions.description: Performs a MIFARE Classic RESTORE operation to copy a value block into the internal transfer register.
requirements: blockAddr must refer to a valid value block.
Authenticate first using PCD_Authenticate.
Follow with MIFARE_Transfer to write to a destination block and check StatusCode.

functions.name: MFRC522::MIFARE_Transfer
functions.description: Performs a MIFARE Classic TRANSFER operation, writing the contents of the internal transfer register to the specified block.
requirements: blockAddr must be a valid (writable) block address.
Authenticate as required for the target block.
Call after MIFARE_Increment/Decrement/Restore; check StatusCode.

functions.name: MFRC522::MIFARE_GetValue
functions.description: Reads a MIFARE Classic value block and decodes its signed 32-bit value into value.
requirements: blockAddr must be a valid value block address; prior authentication required for Classic.
value must be a non-null pointer to receive the decoded value.
Caller must check StatusCode.

functions.name: MFRC522::MIFARE_SetValue
functions.description: Initializes or writes a MIFARE Classic value block with the specified signed 32-bit value (properly formatted with complements and address).
requirements: blockAddr must be a valid writable block address.
Prior authentication required for Classic value blocks.
Caller must check StatusCode.

functions.name: MFRC522::PCD_NTAG216_AUTH
functions.description: Performs the NTAG216 (and similar NTAG21x) password authentication command with the provided password, returning the PACK (password acknowledgement).
requirements: passWord must point to the password bytes (commonly 4 bytes for NTAG21x).
pACK must point to a buffer able to store the PACK response (commonly 2 bytes).
The target PICC must support NTAG password authentication; antenna on; reader initialized.
Caller must check StatusCode.

functions.name: MFRC522::PCD_MIFARE_Transceive
functions.signature: MFRC522::StatusCode MFRC522::PCD_MIFARE_Transceive(byte *sendData, byte sendLen, bool acceptTimeout = false)
functions.description: Transmits a MIFARE command and payload to a PICC and waits for an ACK/NAK. Simplifies MIFARE-specific exchanges where only status is needed.
requirements: sendData must point to at least sendLen bytes.
If acceptTimeout is true, a timeout may be treated as non-fatal depending on context; caller must interpret returned StatusCode.
Reader must be initialized; antenna on.

functions.name: MFRC522::GetStatusCodeName
functions.description: Returns a flash-resident human-readable name for a given StatusCode. Useful for logging without increasing SRAM usage.
requirements: code must be a valid MFRC522::StatusCode value.
Caller should handle unknown values gracefully (implementation may return a generic name).

functions.name: MFRC522::PICC_GetType
functions.description: Maps a SAK (Select Acknowledge) byte returned by a PICC to a known PICC_Type enumeration value.
requirements: sak is the SAK byte obtained after successful selection (PICC_Select).
Caller should handle PICC_TYPE_UNKNOWN and PICC_TYPE_NOT_COMPLETE as needed.

functions.name: MFRC522::PICC_GetTypeName
functions.description: Returns a flash-resident human-readable name for a given PICC_Type. Useful for printing card type information.
requirements: type must be a valid PICC_Type.
Caller should handle unknown/unsupported types.

functions.name: MFRC522::PCD_DumpVersionToSerial
functions.description: Prints MFRC522 version and diagnostic information to the Arduino Serial output for debugging.
requirements: Serial must be initialized (e.g., Serial.begin(...)).
MFRC522 must be connected and initialized.

functions.name: MFRC522::PICC_DumpToSerial
functions.description: Prints a summary and content information of the selected PICC to Serial, based on its UID and type.
requirements: uid must point to a valid, previously obtained UID (e.g., via PICC_ReadCardSerial).
Serial must be initialized.
May require authentication keys for full data access depending on card type.

functions.name: MFRC522::PICC_DumpDetailsToSerial
functions.description: Prints detailed information about a PICC’s UID, SAK and type to Serial.
requirements: uid must be valid and filled via selection.
Serial must be initialized.

functions.name: MFRC522::PICC_DumpMifareClassicToSerial
functions.description: Traverses and prints the contents of a MIFARE Classic card to Serial using the provided key for sector authentication.
requirements: uid must be valid for the selected card.
piccType should correspond to a MIFARE Classic type (e.g., 1K/4K/Mini).
key must point to a 6-byte MIFARE_Key; sectors requiring a different key may fail.
Serial must be initialized.

functions.name: MFRC522::PICC_DumpMifareClassicSectorToSerial
functions.description: Authenticates and prints the data of a single MIFARE Classic sector to Serial.
requirements: uid must be valid for the selected card.
key must be a valid 6-byte MIFARE_Key for the target sector.
sector must be a valid sector index for the card type.
Serial must be initialized.

functions.name: MFRC522::PICC_DumpMifareUltralightToSerial
functions.description: Reads and prints pages of a MIFARE Ultralight or compatible card to Serial for inspection.
requirements: A compatible Ultralight PICC must be present and selected as required by implementation.
Serial must be initialized.

functions.name: MFRC522::MIFARE_SetAccessBits
functions.signature: void MFRC522::MIFARE_SetAccessBits(byte *accessBitBuffer, byte g0, byte g1, byte g2, byte g3)
functions.description: Computes and writes the MIFARE Classic sector trailer access bits (C1/C2/C3 with complements) for groups g0..g3 into the provided buffer.
requirements: accessBitBuffer must point to a buffer with space for the 3 access bytes.
g0..g3 must be valid access setting codes per MIFARE Classic specification.
Caller must later write these bytes to the sector trailer appropriately.

functions.name: MFRC522::MIFARE_OpenUidBackdoor
functions.description: Attempts to use known backdoor sequences on certain Chinese clone MIFARE Classic cards to allow UID writing. Returns true on success.
requirements: Only applicable to specific clone cards; invoking on genuine cards will fail.
Risk of bricking or altering security; use in test environments only.
If logErrors is true, function may print diagnostic messages.

functions.name: MFRC522::MIFARE_SetUid
functions.signature: bool MFRC522::MIFARE_SetUid(byte *newUid, byte uidSize, bool logErrors)
functions.description: Writes a new UID to compatible clone MIFARE Classic cards using backdoor methods. Returns true on success.
requirements: newUid must point to uidSize bytes (uidSize typically 4, 7, or 10).
Only works on compatible clone cards that support UID writing; otherwise fails.
Changing UID can render the card unusable; use with caution.
If logErrors is true, function may print diagnostics.

functions.name: MFRC522::MIFARE_UnbrickUidSector
functions.description: Attempts to recover a bricked UID sector on certain clone MIFARE cards by restoring a valid sector trailer/UID configuration.
requirements: Only applicable to specific clone cards and scenarios where UID sector is corrupted.
Operation is risky; use in controlled environments.
If logErrors is true, function may print diagnostics.

functions.name: MFRC522::PICC_IsNewCardPresent
functions.description: Checks if a new ISO14443A PICC is present in the field since the last check, without selecting it.
requirements: MFRC522 must be initialized and antenna on.
Caller should poll periodically; returns true if a card is detected.

functions.name: MFRC522::PICC_ReadCardSerial
functions.description: Performs anti-collision and selection to read the UID of a PICC and store it in the public member uid.
requirements: A PICC must be present in the RF field.
MFRC522 must be initialized; antenna on.
On success, MFRC522::uid is populated; returns true/false for success.

functions.name: MFRC522Extended::MFRC522Extended
functions.description: Default constructor for the extended MFRC522 class that adds ISO/IEC 14443-4 support. Does not initialize hardware until PCD_Init() is called.
requirements: Call an appropriate PCD_Init() before use.
Hardware wiring and SPI requirements are the same as MFRC522.

functions.name: MFRC522Extended::MFRC522Extended
functions.description: Constructor specifying the reset/power-down pin for the extended reader class.
requirements: rst must be connected to MFRC522 NRSTPD.
Call a matching PCD_Init(...) before use.

functions.name: MFRC522Extended::MFRC522Extended
functions.description: Constructor specifying chip-select and reset pins for the extended reader class.
requirements: ss must be connected to MFRC522 NSS; rst to NRSTPD.
Call PCD_Init(ss, rst) before communication.

functions.name: MFRC522Extended::PICC_Select
functions.description: Overrides PICC_Select to support ISO/IEC 14443-4 interaction nuances while selecting a PICC and filling the Uid.
requirements: uid must be a valid pointer; validBits in 0..7 when used.
Reader initialized; antenna on; caller checks StatusCode.

functions.name: MFRC522Extended::PICC_RequestATS
functions.description: Sends RATS to a selected ISO/IEC 14443-4 PICC and parses the ATS (Answer To Select) into the provided Ats structure.
requirements: A PICC must be selected first via anti-collision/selection.
ats must be a valid pointer to receive ATS data; its data[] capacity is limited to FIFO_SIZE - 2 by the class definition.
Reader initialized; antenna on; caller checks StatusCode.

functions.name: MFRC522Extended::PICC_PPS
functions.description: Sends a PPS (Protocol and Parameter Selection) command to keep current bit rates (same D in both directions).
requirements: A PICC supporting ISO/IEC 14443-4 must be selected.
Caller must check StatusCode.
Reader initialized; antenna on.

functions.name: MFRC522Extended::PICC_PPS
functions.description: Sends a PPS command requesting different D (bit rates) for PCD->PICC and PICC->PCD directions.
requirements: sendBitRate and receiveBitRate must be valid TagBitRates enum values.
A selected ISO/IEC 14443-4 PICC is required.
Caller must check StatusCode.

functions.name: MFRC522Extended::TCL_Transceive
functions.description: Transmits a formatted ISO/IEC 14443-4 I-Block/R-Block/S-Block (in PcbBlock form) and receives a response into back, handling block numbering as needed.
requirements: send must describe a valid PCB block; its prologue and INF must be properly set.
back must be a valid pointer to receive the response block.
A selected ISO/IEC 14443-4 PICC is required; caller must check StatusCode.

functions.name: MFRC522Extended::TCL_Transceive
functions.signature: MFRC522Extended::StatusCode MFRC522Extended::TCL_Transceive(TagInfo * tag, byte *sendData, byte sendLen, byte *backData = NULL, byte *backLen = NULL)
functions.description: Transmits raw ISO/IEC 14443-4 application data to the selected tag and optionally receives response bytes. Manages chaining and block numbering via tag context.
requirements: tag must point to a valid TagInfo previously obtained/selected.
sendData must point to at least sendLen bytes.
If backLen is non-null, it must contain the input buffer capacity and will be set to actual length; backData must have at least that capacity.
Caller must check StatusCode.

functions.name: MFRC522Extended::TCL_TransceiveRBlock
functions.signature: MFRC522Extended::StatusCode MFRC522Extended::TCL_TransceiveRBlock(TagInfo *tag, bool ack, byte *backData = NULL, byte *backLen = NULL)
functions.description: Sends an ISO/IEC 14443-4 R-Block (ACK or NAK depending on ack flag) to the selected tag and optionally receives the next chained data.
requirements: tag must be a valid TagInfo with current blockNumber state.
If backLen is non-null, it must point to buffer capacity and will be updated; backData must have at least that capacity.
Caller must check StatusCode.

functions.name: MFRC522Extended::TCL_Deselect
functions.description: Sends a DESELECT (S(DESELECT)) to terminate ISO/IEC 14443-4 communication with the tag.
requirements: tag must be a valid TagInfo for the currently selected card.
Caller must check StatusCode; antenna must be on, reader initialized.

functions.name: MFRC522Extended::PICC_GetType
functions.description: Determines the PICC type from the extended TagInfo (using ATQA/SAK/ATS as needed) and returns a PICC_Type.
requirements: tag must be a valid pointer with filled fields from selection/ATS.
Caller should handle PICC_TYPE_UNKNOWN and related values.

functions.name: MFRC522Extended::PICC_DumpToSerial
functions.description: Prints a summary of an ISO/IEC 14443-4 tag’s information (including ATS fields) to Serial.
requirements: tag must be valid and populated.
Serial must be initialized.

functions.name: MFRC522Extended::PICC_DumpDetailsToSerial
functions.description: Prints detailed ISO/IEC 14443-4 tag information (ATQA, UID, ATS, bit rates, features) to Serial.
requirements: tag must be valid and populated.
Serial must be initialized.

functions.name: MFRC522Extended::PICC_DumpISO14443_4
functions.description: Outputs ISO/IEC 14443-4 specific details and possibly exchanges to Serial for debugging.
requirements: tag must be valid and refer to a selected tag.
Serial must be initialized.

functions.name: MFRC522Extended::PICC_IsNewCardPresent
functions.description: Overrides presence check with ISO/IEC 14443-4 aware behavior; returns true if a new card is detected.
requirements: Reader must be initialized; antenna on.

functions.name: MFRC522Extended::PICC_ReadCardSerial
functions.description: Overrides UID read/selection to populate MFRC522::uid and MFRC522Extended::tag structures as appropriate. Returns true on success.
requirements: A PICC must be present in the field.
Reader must be initialized; antenna on.
